## Sales Tax Agency

Stored: `agencyId`, `name`, `state`, `ratePpm`, `frequency` (filing frequency) and `openingOwedMinor` (owed at conversion).

It reads `invoices` (posted Invoices with this `agencyId`), `journal` (every Journal Month) and `closes` (every Month Close). `collectedMinor` is the invoices' `taxMinor` plus the `taxMinor` fact of standing `sales-receipt` postings for this agency; `taxableMinor` is the invoice line amounts plus those receipts' item amounts. `paidMinor` sums `bank-payment` postings whose `payee` fact is this agency. `owedMinor` is opening owed plus collected less paid, and `glOwedMinor` is account 2200's credit balance; the page shows whether they tie.

```ts
import { TaxAgency } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-registers';

@field agency = linksTo(TaxAgency);
```

### Non-goals
No operations and no return preparation; the rate is a single stored figure per agency.

What each sale owes the agency comes from its tax lines when it has them, counting a code's taxable amount once however many of the agency's rates it carries, and otherwise from its single rate.

### Example
`TaxAgency/wa-dor`, a quarterly filer at an illustrative 9.5%.
